report.speaker: first
lines: Engine's up. I've set the SMES.
I've done the rounds. Nothing's on fire.
Power's holding. Don't ask me for how long.

catch.speaker: first
lines: Don't touch the emitters. Just don't.
Somebody's been at the pipes again. I can smell it.
The crystal's humming a new note. Probably fine.
An assistant asked me for insuls twice. I said no twice.

resigned.speaker: second
lines: Noted. I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
It's always probably fine. Until it isn't.
If it goes, it goes. I'll be in the break room.
